title: Commercial Use of Plan Vehicles — Alignment Services & Plans Coverage Rule
content:
**Holding a Crestline Fleet Account changes what an alignment plan of Alignment Services & Plans covers on the fleet's vehicles.**

A plan whose line may not be used on a vehicle in commercial use gives no included alignment on a date when the vehicle is in commercial use; the alignment is charged the line's member early-alignment price instead, and the plan's interval is not restarted. A vehicle is in commercial use on a date when its usage class is commercial, or when its latest entry on a Crestline Fleet Account roster is an enrollment of the vehicle on the fleet.

The plan is not cancelled or refunded for this reason, and included alignments resume once the vehicle is back in personal use. Single services, whose lines may be used on a vehicle in commercial use, are unaffected and may be charged to a fleet account.

### Truth table on the alignment date
| Line may be used in commercial use | Vehicle in commercial use on the date | Result |
|---|---|---|
| No (a plan line) | Yes | member early-alignment price charged; interval not restarted; plan stays in force |
| No (a plan line) | No | this rule does not apply |
| Yes (a single service) | Yes | unaffected; may be charged to a fleet account |

*Hypothetical:* a car on a 3-Year plan is enrolled on its owner's fleet roster in spring and its latest roster entry later records it leaving the fleet; alignments while it was enrolled were charged the member early price, and included alignments resume once it is back in personal use.
